summary: The customer called to dispute an unexpected extra roaming charge on their bill. The agent located the account, identified the charge as a roaming fee, and offered to open a dispute ticket when the customer denied traveling. The call ended with the agent promising to submit the dispute.

evidence.text: I can submit a dispute w open a ticket, okay?
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Submit a dispute and open a ticket for the roaming charge

evidence.text: Sure wallah, bas give me your account number, w la tatemmesh, I will check el tafaseel right now.
evidence.speaker: Agent

compliance_flags.description: The agent asked for the account number but did not verify the customer's identity by requesting additional personal details before discussing account specifics.

evidence.text: Sure wallah, bas give me your account number, w la tatemmesh, I will check el tafaseel right now.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent used overly casual mixed Arabic-English language and slang ('la tatemmesh') which is unprofessional for a contact center.

evidence.text: Wallah hek el system b2oul, bas la tkhaf, I can submit a dispute w open a ticket, okay?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent offered some reassurance ('la tkhaf'), but was dismissive of the customer's denial by simply blaming the system first.

evidence.text: I can submit a dispute w open a ticket, okay?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully identified the next required step (submitting a dispute ticket) to address the customer's issue.

evidence.text: El account number, the nine-digit number on top of your bill, ba3deen I will explain shu heya el fees hadi.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent gave instructions on finding the account number, though the heavy code-switching can sometimes reduce clarity.

evidence.text: Yareet wallah, shukran kteer, please fix it saria3an.
evidence.speaker: Customer

rubric_scores.justification: The agent failed to properly close the call, offering no summary of next steps or professional closing statement before the customer finished speaking.

evidence.text: Achaft el system, hadi roaming fee min el shahr el maadi, when you traveled.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately reported what the system showed as the reason for the charge, though the charge itself was contested.

evidence.text: Sure wallah, bas give me your account number, w la tatemmesh, I will check el tafaseel right now.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent failed to follow proper verification procedures before discussing sensitive billing details.

quote.text: Ahlan, ya akhi ana shufet el bill taba3i u fi extra charge wallah mesh fahem shu hada, can you repeat please?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Okay, bas slow down thwayya please, shu el raqam elly talabtah?

quote.text: Aah, okay, one second, it is 452109837, so shu haqq el zeyadeh elly edfa3tha?
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Roaming? Bas ana ma sefert, wallah ma sefert! Can you say that again, kif ya3ni?
quote.speaker: Customer
